card.name: Linking words before education topic nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'about' and commas in lists, right after nouns like knowledge, training or myths. Mostly in course, training and school-program descriptions.

modes.label: Of/about after knowledge or training
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'about' follows a noun like knowledge, understanding, training or myths and introduces the subject taught.

modes.description: A comma between items in a short list of life or work areas.
